algorithm.coordinateRule: All rectangles half-open, global integer coordinates, no resampling/registration/feather/color changes.
algorithm.rootHaloReconstruction: Read recorded padded_source_id plane. For padded pixel(pX,pY), id=plane[pY,pX], original source local=(pX-source.paddedOrigin.x,pY-source.paddedOrigin.y). Copy that recorded source pixel. Never recompute a new seam or infer latest raw attempt.
algorithm.currentCorePriority: Overlay all pixels lying inside each of the three current4096 candidate global boxes. Own tile interior must be byte-exact current candidate; for lateral halos that lie inside an adjacent current candidate, use that adjacent current core at the same global position. Outside their4096 boxes retain recorded root native halo.
algorithm.patchExtraction: For sc=1..4 extract root padded crop[(sc-1)*1024,0,(sc-1)*1024+1254,1254] after same-coordinate current-core overlay. This supplies global y8077..9331. Do not crop only4096 and edge-repeat it; that would invent halo pixels.
algorithm.overlapToNewR02BottomRow: Use anchor source crop[0,0,1254,230] and paste at target local[0,1024]. Global overlap y8077..8307 contains115px existing native north halo and115px current r03 core. Targetr02_s04 core ends at y8192.
algorithm.proofSidecar: Derived reference declares isAiGeneration=false,rawNative=false,mechanicalReference=true,actualModel=null. Pin current candidates/records,root assembly,npz,and all used source/generation hashes; record per-pixel source ownership or region planes including current-core priority. Do not forge builtin generation metadata or place derived references in old native/.
assertions: All own current core pixels exactly equal current4096 same-global-coordinate pixels.
Lateral overlap pixels inside another known current4096 exactly equal that adjacent core.
Fallback halo pixel equals recorded original source at formula coordinate.
Full1254×1254 coverage,no unassigned source IDs,no resizing or blend.
Versioned output only inside this batch;exclusive new writes.

reviewLocations: All12 r02_s04/r03_s01 paired230px strips after new output.
r03_s01 adjacent-source230px joins,especially current-core/old-halo transition at globaly8192.
Cross-tile junctions globalx8192 and12288 at y8192;inside-row halo pixels from neighboring current cores take precedence.
Outer ends globalx4096 and16384:neighbor current cores not included in these three anchors;root halo remains provisional.
Any current-vs-root changed bbox within first1254 rows must survive export; inspect these directly in current4096 when choosing the anchor.
